finalText:
**Renamed `calcTotal` to `computeTotal` everywhere.**

Four files changed: `cart.js`, `index.js`, `invoice.js`, `report.js`. That covers the function itself, both exports, and all three call sites. The doc comment in `cart.js` now says the new name too.

The tests already used the new name, so I left them alone. One of them checks that `cart.calcTotal` is gone, and it is.

All 4 tests pass in 74ms.
